adhd.title: Tiny Start
adhd.use_when: Task initiation is blocked by overwhelm, perfectionism, low energy, or unclear first steps.

adhd.title: Working Memory Externalization
adhd.use_when: The person keeps losing steps, ideas, or intentions.

adhd.title: Transition Bridge
adhd.use_when: Stopping one activity and beginning another is hard.

adhd.title: Body Double
adhd.use_when: Presence helps task initiation or persistence.

autism.title: Sensory Map
autism.use_when: Overload, shutdown, irritability, pain, or fatigue may be affected by sensory input.

autism.title: Shutdown Support
autism.use_when: Speech, movement, decision-making, or processing has dropped sharply under stress.

autism.title: Meltdown Recovery
autism.use_when: The nervous system is overloaded and behavioral control is reduced.

autism.title: Burnout Load Reduction
autism.use_when: Sustained overload, masking, demands, or insufficient recovery have reduced capacity.

autism.title: Predictable Transition
autism.use_when: Change or uncertainty is increasing distress.

cbt.title: Thought Record
cbt.use_when: A strong emotion is linked to a specific interpretation or prediction.

cbt.title: Behavioral Activation
cbt.use_when: Low mood or avoidance has reduced meaningful activity.

cbt.title: Structured Problem Solving
cbt.use_when: A solvable problem is looping without a concrete plan.

cbt.title: Worry Window
cbt.use_when: Repetitive worry is consuming the day.

cbt.title: Graded Practice
cbt.use_when: Avoidance is maintaining fear and the target is safe, consensual, and appropriate for gradual practice.

dbt.title: STOP
dbt.use_when: A strong urge may lead to an impulsive action.

dbt.title: TIPP
dbt.use_when: High physiological arousal needs short-term downshifting.

dbt.title: ACCEPTS
dbt.use_when: Short-term distraction is needed to survive a distress spike without making things worse.

dbt.title: Check the Facts
dbt.use_when: Emotion intensity may be amplified by assumptions or incomplete information.

dbt.title: Opposite Action
dbt.use_when: An emotion or urge does not fit the facts or acting on it would be ineffective.

dbt.title: DEAR MAN
dbt.use_when: A clear request, refusal, or boundary is needed.

dbt.title: GIVE
dbt.use_when: The relationship matters during a conversation.

dbt.title: FAST
dbt.use_when: Self-respect needs protection in an interpersonal situation.

dbt.title: Behavior Chain Analysis
dbt.use_when: A behavior needs a no-blame map of what led to it and what could change next time.

psychiatric_support.title: Structured Psychiatric Check-In
psychiatric_support.use_when: The person wants to summarize symptoms and functioning for themselves or a clinician.

psychiatric_support.title: Clinician Visit Preparation
psychiatric_support.use_when: A visit is coming up and important information needs organization.

psychiatric_support.title: Medication Journal
psychiatric_support.use_when: The person wants to track medication experience without changing treatment.

psychiatric_support.title: Reality-Grounded Support
psychiatric_support.use_when: A person reports paranoia, hallucinations, or unusual beliefs.

general_mental_health.title: 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding
general_mental_health.use_when: The person feels flooded, panicky, detached, or stuck in looping thoughts and sensory grounding is tolerable.

general_mental_health.title: Dissociation Anchor
general_mental_health.use_when: The person feels unreal, detached, foggy, or disconnected.

general_mental_health.title: Grief Support
general_mental_health.use_when: Loss is producing waves of sadness, numbness, anger, longing, or disorientation.

general_mental_health.title: Sleep Wind-Down
general_mental_health.use_when: The person wants a low-pressure sleep routine.

physical_health.title: Symptom Journal
physical_health.use_when: Symptoms need organized tracking for self-management or a clinician.

physical_health.title: Accessibility-Aware Care Plan
physical_health.use_when: A care task conflicts with mobility, pain, fatigue, sensory, communication, or caregiver limits.

physical_health.title: Follow Existing Medical Plan
physical_health.use_when: A health condition already has clinician instructions.

physical_health.title: Medical Emergency Escalation
physical_health.use_when: Clear emergency symptoms may be present.
